recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-18237. If the work group wants the Simple FHIRPath page's location list synchronized with every current fhirpath.html#simple reference, handle that as a separate broader cleanup rather than reopening this applied ActivityDefinition issue.
issue_request: FHIR-18237 was Published/Persuasive for the CDS work group and requested that ActivityDefinition.dynamicValue.path clarify path resolution rules by using the same rule family as DataRequirement path elements, without copying DataRequirement-specific result-type restrictions.
initial_application: Historical commit 66795a305d9328c8429b94d078be48a68321c218 explicitly applied GF#18237 to the then-authoritative ActivityDefinition spreadsheet. Later source migration preserved the wording in structuredefinition-ActivityDefinition.xml, and commit 60e98c41f6c5fab597bbdb8d7ec41898ca4ec777 corrected the spelling of "resolvable".
additional_context: ActivityDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini. Current DataRequirement path definitions use the same Simple FHIRPath rule family and add result-type restrictions specific to their filters. A broader pre-existing Simple FHIRPath page location-list gap affects multiple elements that reference fhirpath.html#simple, so a narrow FHIR-18237 edit to that list would be incomplete and is not needed for this seed decision. Community searches found no relevant conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source files were edited because ActivityDefinition.dynamicValue.path already states that the path SHALL be a FHIRPath resolvable on the specified target type and SHALL consist only of identifiers, constant indexers, and a restricted subset of functions, with qualifier and indexer traversal described.
